results.name: Season 1, Episode 1: Seinfeld

search_tv.name: search_tv

parameters.description: The show, season or episode title to look for.
parameters.name: term

parameters.description: Optional. Individual episodes, or whole seasons. Leave blank for the store's own mix.
parameters.name: entity

parameters.description: Optional. Which field the search text has to match: the show, the season, the episode, the description. Leave blank to match anywhere.
parameters.name: attribute

parameters.description: Optional. Which country's store to search. United States by default. This is not cosmetic: catalogues, prices and release dates differ per storefront, and an item on sale in one country may not exist in another.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Optional. Whether to include items carrying an explicit-content advisory. On by default, which is what the store itself does. Turn it off to keep a workflow's output safe for work.
parameters.name: explicit

parameters.description: Optional. How many items to return. Between 1 and 200, which is Apple's own ceiling; 25 by default.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional. How many matches to skip before this page. Use the next offset from the previous result to page through. 0 by default. The store returns at most 200 matches for a search, so this plus the number of results cannot go past 200.
parameters.name: offset

attribute.description: The field the term was matched against. Null when none was set.

count.description: How many items are in this result.

country.description: The storefront that was searched, e.g. US.

entity.description: The kind of result that was asked for. Null when none was set.

has_more.description: True when the store had more matches than this page holds.

max_results_reached.description: True when paging ran into Apple's ceiling of 200 matches per search. There may be more items in the store, but this API will not return them: narrow the search to reach them.

next_offset.description: The Skip value that fetches the next page. Null when this is the last one.

results.description: The matching items, in the order the store ranked them.

items.description: One item from the iTunes Store, in the shape every action returns.

app.description: The fields only an App Store app has. Null for every other kind of result.

advisories.description: Apple's content advisories, e.g. Infrequent Violence.

average_user_rating.description: The star rating out of 5, across all versions.

bundle_id.description: The app's bundle identifier, e.g. com.tinyspeck.chatlyio.

current_version_released_at.description: When the current version shipped, as an ISO 8601 instant.

ipad_screenshot_urls.description: The iPad screenshots shown on the store listing.

is_game_center_enabled.description: Whether the app uses Game Center.

languages.description: The languages the app is localised into, as ISO codes.

minimum_os_version.description: The oldest OS version the app runs on.

release_notes.description: What the developer says changed in this version.

screenshot_urls.description: The iPhone screenshots shown on the store listing.

seller_name.description: The legal name of the developer selling the app.

supported_devices.description: The device models the app installs on.

user_rating_count.description: How many ratings that average is built from.

version.description: The version currently on the store.

artist_id.description: The artist, author, developer or show behind the item. Pass it to List an artist's albums or List an artist's songs.

artist_name.description: The artist, author, developer or podcast creator.

artist_url.description: The artist's page in the store.

artwork_url.description: The cover art, at the largest size Apple published for this item. Use Download artwork to get the picture itself, at any size, as a file.

artwork_url_100.description: The same cover art at 100 x 100, for a thumbnail.

collection_id.description: The album, season, audiobook or podcast this item belongs to. Pass it to List an album's tracks.

collection_name.description: The album, season, audiobook or podcast's title.

collection_price.description: What the whole album, season or audiobook costs.

collection_url.description: The collection's page in the store.

content_advisory_rating.description: The age or content rating, e.g. PG-13, 12+, Clean.

country.description: The storefront that answered, as Apple's 3-letter code.

currency.description: The currency the prices are in, e.g. USD.

description.description: The longest blurb Apple published for the item: the film synopsis, the app description, the episode's show notes. Null for songs and albums, which carry none.

disc_count.description: How many discs or seasons there are in total.

disc_number.description: Which disc of a set, or which season of a show.

duration.description: The same length written the way a person reads it, e.g. 3:42.

duration_ms.description: How long the track runs, in milliseconds.

episode.description: The fields only a podcast episode has. Null for every other kind of result.

audio_url.description: The full audio file, as published in the show's feed.

closed_captioning.description: Apple's closed-captioning state for the episode.

content_type.description: Whether the episode is audio or video.

file_extension.description: The audio file's extension, e.g. mp3.

guid.description: The episode's id in the show's own RSS feed. It is stable across storefronts, so it is what to store when checking for episodes already seen.

feed_url.description: A podcast's RSS feed. This is the address to hand to a feed reader, and the only field here Apple does not host itself.

formatted_price.description: The price as the store writes it, e.g. $9.99 or Free. Books and apps carry this; music does not.

genre.description: The item's primary genre, e.g. Rock or Daily News.

genres.description: Every genre Apple lists for the item, primary one first.

id.description: The item's own iTunes id: the most specific one it carries, so a song reports its track id and an album its collection id. Feed it straight back into Look up by ID.

is_explicit.description: True only for an item carrying an explicit advisory. A censored edit of an explicit track reports false.

is_streamable.description: Whether Apple Music can stream the song.

kind.description: What the item is, in Apple's vocabulary: song, album, feature-movie, podcast, podcast-episode, ebook, software, tv-episode, music-video, Artist.

name.description: The item's own title, whichever kind of item it is: the song for a song, the album for an album, the artist's name for an artist.

preview_url.description: Apple's 30-second preview of the track, or the full audio file for a podcast episode. Apple's terms require previews to be streamed rather than saved.

price.description: What this item costs on its own. Null when it is not sold separately, or is free, or the storefront does not price it.

release_date.description: The day it was released, YYYY-MM-DD.

released_at.description: The same release, as the full ISO 8601 instant Apple sent. Podcast episodes carry a real time of day here.

track_count.description: How many tracks or episodes the collection holds.

track_id.description: The individual track, episode, app or book's id. Null on a row that is itself a collection or an artist.

track_name.description: The individual track, episode, app or book's title.

track_number.description: Position on the album, or episode number within a season.

track_url.description: The track's own page in the store.

url.description: The page that opens this item in the store.

wrapper_type.description: Apple's coarser grouping: track, collection, artist, audiobook or podcastEpisode.

term.description: The text that was searched for.

description: Search Apple's whole store from a workflow: music, podcasts, apps, books, audiobooks, TV and music videos, with the artwork, prices, ratings, release dates and previews the store publishes. Look items up by their iTunes ID, an album's barcode, a book's ISBN or an AllMusic ID; walk an artist's albums and songs, an album's tracks, a podcast's episodes or a season's episodes; and download cover art as a file to post or attach. Any of Apple's 183 country storefronts can be searched, which is how prices and availability are compared between them. No account or API key is required.
